description: Ferdinand Bolstraat 40-54 (1875-77): 5.4-6.2 m shop-street fronts of a shop and three upper storeys of red-brown brick (some painted grey or cream); three axes of white T-windows under segmental heads, each under a cream moulded-brick hood frieze; white sills; a white frieze and cornice at 13.8 m; one white pediment dormer with a hoist beam over the middle axis

door-left.note: a residential door at the left party wall beside the shop
